name: prompt-901
image_purpose: Beauty selfie post and natural-skin moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic close-up bathroom selfie with natural freckles and unretouched smartphone texture.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with dirty-blonde-to-light-blonde hair, visible roots, light blue-gray eyes, sharp black winged eyeliner, heavy freckles across nose and cheeks, and natural skin grain. She wears a heather-gray ribbed knit tank top with secure straps, small gold hoops, a gold G pendant and a longer kangaroo pendant, looking directly at the lens with a relaxed pout.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 chest-up handheld selfie from slightly above eye level, face sharp with gentle falloff on shoulders. Include dark brown-gray glossy bathroom tile, chrome shower fixture at left, and top of white ceramic toilet tank at right.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused overhead bathroom light, natural warm indoor mix, gentle shadows beneath chin and hair, candid cool-girl atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 24-28mm smartphone wide-angle look, 3:4 close-up, realistic freckles, pores, hair strands, rib-knit texture and tile reflections, subtle digital noise, no airbrushing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic 3:4 close-up bathroom selfie of one approved adult blonde woman with dirty-blonde-to-light-blonde hair, visible roots, light blue-gray eyes, sharp black winged eyeliner, heavy freckles across her nose and cheeks, and natural skin grain. She wears a heather-gray ribbed knit tank top with secure straps, small gold hoops, a gold G pendant, and a longer kangaroo pendant, looking directly at the lens with a relaxed pout. Use a slightly elevated 24-28mm smartphone perspective, dark glossy bathroom tiles, chrome shower fixture at left, white ceramic toilet tank at right, soft diffused overhead light, realistic pores and fabric, gentle falloff, and candid natural-skin social-media realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
